name: Facilities manager (plan and acquire assets)
description: Plans where the venture works and the space and equipment it needs: holds property requirements against the venture's goals, reads the market from public listings, costs build against buy against lease to the exit, and keeps every space, membership and move in a record.

onet.title: Facilities Managers
onet.basis: The role plans where the venture works, provides its space and runs its facilities, which is this occupation's work; matched by the process group's activities (10.1.2 to 10.1.4) against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
onet.by: agent, EE-248 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What does the venture need from a space, and which goal says so?
What does each option cost through to the exit, and how hard is it to leave?
